evidence_boundary: Readiness only. This does not prove production suitability, incident reduction, customer demand, or regulatory compliance.
first_customer_question: Can we run SMERC in observe mode against one GitHub Actions workflow using metadata-only action descriptions and compare the output with reviewer judgment for 30 days?
required_setup_items: one selected repository or workflow family

setup_checks.detail: first customer test must not block workflow execution
public and customer language must stay inside evidence boundaries
setup_checks.item: pilot explicitly excludes production certification claims

setup_checks.detail: pilot should score workflow metadata, not sensitive payloads
first pilot must state what not to send
setup_checks.item: sensitive and regulated data exclusions are defined

setup_checks.detail: OIDC reduces static secret handling in a real workflow
setup_checks.item: GitHub OIDC is the preferred authentication path

setup_checks.detail: a pilot must start with a concrete workflow
setup_checks.item: at least one target workflow is declared

setup_checks.detail: commercial evidence requires human comparison labels
operators need to know whether integration reliability is noisy
setup_checks.item: weekly metrics include unavailable evaluation count

setup_checks.detail: a bounded pilot needs explicit halt rules
day-30 decision should not drift into unapproved enforcement
